# eSIMfly Business API

> HTTPS API for resellers to sell eSIM data packages worldwide: catalogue, ordering, top-ups,
> usage, diagnostics and real-time webhooks. HMAC-SHA256 authentication. Base URL https://esimfly.net/api/v1/business

## Start here (AI-ready prompts)

- [Complete integration prompt — all endpoints + recommended architecture](https://docs.esimfly.net/llm/esimfly-api-full-prompt.txt): paste into your coding assistant to generate a full integration. Recommends syncing the package catalogue into your own database instead of proxying the API.
- [AI / LLM integration guide (HTML)](https://docs.esimfly.net/docs/llm-integration)
